meaning: Newly authored generic proposals; source-derived profile evidence stays separate

cards.title: Single-slide claim
cards.when: The audience needs the conclusion first.
cards.avoid_when: Complete derivation or multidimensional lookup is the main need.
steps: Choose a structure that supports it
Check text and graphics at viewing distance

worked_example.choose: Support the claim with an actual metric
worked_example.avoid: Present six unrelated features as a conclusion
worked_example.reason: One slide needs a clear argument

cards.title: Comparable alternatives
steps: Align rows or columns by dimension

worked_example.choose: Show each dimension side by side; mark unknowns
worked_example.avoid: List strengths on one side and weaknesses on the other

cards.title: Process and branches
steps: Split complex branches while preserving context

worked_example.avoid: Draw parallel benefits as a chain of arrows
worked_example.reason: Arrows can invent causality or time

cards.title: Data-backed argument
cards.when: Real data supports comparison, trend or distribution.
cards.avoid_when: Data is absent or its basis is unclear.
steps: Choose encoding by the comparison goal

worked_example.input: Waiting times decline over three months
worked_example.choose: Label units and the three-month window
worked_example.reason: Graphics cannot replace correct quantitative relationships

cards.title: Cross-slide narrative
cards.when: The audience must move from a problem to action.
cards.avoid_when: The requested scope is single-slide visual study.
steps: Turn unsupported leaps into open questions
checks: Removing a slide reveals its reasoning role

worked_example.avoid: Concatenate department sections without a shared question
worked_example.reason: Cross-slide relations let the audience follow

cards.title: Representative and stress slides
cards.when: Test whether learned layouts accept new content.
cards.avoid_when: Parsed structure is being mistaken for rendered success.
steps: Make a typical and boundary case
Check native delivery separately when required

worked_example.input: Replace a short title with a longer conclusion
worked_example.choose: Reorganize hierarchy or split a slide without losing meaning
worked_example.avoid: Shrink type repeatedly until it fits
worked_example.reason: Capacity calls for structure choices, not mechanical compression
